question: Which word is closest in meaning to 'Castigate'?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Condemn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Castigate"** means to criticize or reprimand someone severely. It often refers to harsh punishment or verbal scolding. (कड़ी आलोचना करना / डांटना)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher castigated the student for not completing the assignment on time.
 
 
 
• **"Condemn"** means to express strong disapproval of something, often in a formal or public manner. It is closely related to castigate as it also involves strong criticism. (निंदा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The government condemned the violent protests that erupted in the city.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word closest in meaning to **'Castigate' **is **'Condemn'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Condemn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vague** (अस्पष्ट): Not clear in meaning or expression; uncertain or ambiguous.

 
 
• **Example:** Her explanation of the project was so vague that no one understood the purpose.
 
 
 
• **Dull** (नीरस): Lacking brightness, sharpness, or interest; boring.
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so dull that half the audience fell asleep.
 
 
 
• **Dark** (अंधेरा): Having little or no light; gloomy or mysterious.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was dark and filled with an eerie silence.
